# `@videojs/spf/hls/features/start-position`

Source: [src/playback/engines/hls/features/start-position.ts](../../../src/playback/engines/hls/features/start-position.ts)

## startPositionFeature

Starts playback at `state.startPosition` instead of zero. Also performs the seeks other features request through
`state.startPosition`, such as the live edge and the AirPlay session-end restore.

### Behaviors

1. [applyStartPosition](../behaviors/dom/apply-start-position.md#applystartposition)

| `presentation` | `MaybeResolvedPresentation \| undefined` | [applyStartPosition](../behaviors/dom/apply-start-position.md#applystartposition) | No description. |
| `startPosition` | `number \| undefined` | [applyStartPosition](../behaviors/dom/apply-start-position.md#applystartposition) | One-shot start-position command in presentation-timeline seconds. Written by consumers (adapter, recovery snapshot — e.g. `setupAirPlay`'s at a session's settled end); consumed (cleared) by `applyStartPosition` once the element seeks. |
